name: PR439 frozen pre-W3 six-seed characterization

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-w3-prewire-six-seed

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr439-pre-w3-six-seed
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  measure:
    name: Run frozen #435 six-seed pre-W3 arm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_SHA: 876a3343319050187c2a5505b18cb32fc3d0f89d
      REASON: "PR #439 pre-W3 arm; production pinned to PR base, evidence-only test/parser backport"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prove production tree is exact PR base
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          actual_base="$(git merge-base HEAD "$EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_SHA")"
          test "$actual_base" = "$EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_SHA"

          mapfile -t changed < <(git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_SHA"...HEAD | sort)
          printf 'Evidence-only delta:\n%s\n' "${changed[*]}"
          expected=(
            ".github/workflows/pr439-w3-prewire-six-seed.yml"
            "src/match-engine/tests/FoulRateDiagnosticTests.cs"
            "tools/dotnet-ci/parse_foul_card_characterization.py"
          )
          printf '%s\n' "${changed[@]}" > /tmp/changed
          printf '%s\n' "${expected[@]}" | sort > /tmp/expected
          sort -o /tmp/changed /tmp/changed
          diff -u /tmp/expected /tmp/changed

          if git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_SHA"...HEAD -- src             ':(exclude)src/match-engine/tests/FoulRateDiagnosticTests.cs' | grep -q .; then
            echo "::error::Pre-W3 evidence arm changes production src/."
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Resolve canonical instrument
        shell: bash
        env:
          INSTRUMENT: foul-rate
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py validate --repo .
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py resolve             "$INSTRUMENT" --repo . --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build gate and run frozen pre-W3 instrument
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/measurements/trx
          OUT="artifacts/measurements/measurement.txt"
          MEASURE_OUT="artifacts/measurements/instrument-output.txt"
          RESULTS="artifacts/measurements/trx"
          RUNSETTINGS="artifacts/measurements/measurement.runsettings"

          cat > "$RUNSETTINGS" <<'XML'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <RunSettings>
            <RunConfiguration>
              <TreatNoTestsAsError>true</TreatNoTestsAsError>
            </RunConfiguration>
          </RunSettings>
          XML

          {
            echo "# Frozen #435 / PR439 PRE-W3 characterization"
            echo "# workflow evidence SHA: $GITHUB_SHA"
            echo "# production base:       $EXPECTED_PRODUCTION_SHA"
            echo "# run:                   $GITHUB_RUN_ID (attempt $GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT)"
            echo "# instrument:            $MEASUREMENT_INSTRUMENT"
            echo "# reason:                $REASON"
            echo
          } > "$OUT"

          set +e
          env -u "$MEASUREMENT_ENV" bash tools/dotnet-ci/run-gate.sh             --test-filter "$MEASUREMENT_FILTER" 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUT"
          gate_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e
          test "$gate_status" -eq 0

          set +e
          env "$MEASUREMENT_ENV=1" dotnet test "$MEASUREMENT_PROJECT"             --no-build --no-restore             --filter "$MEASUREMENT_FILTER"             --settings "$RUNSETTINGS"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"             --logger "trx;LogFileName=measurement.trx"             --results-directory "$RESULTS" 2>&1 | tee "$MEASURE_OUT" | tee -a "$OUT"
          measurement_status="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
          set -e
          test "$measurement_status" -eq 0

          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/measurement_catalog.py verify-run             "$MEASUREMENT_INSTRUMENT" --trx-dir "$RESULTS" --output "$MEASURE_OUT" | tee -a "$OUT"

          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/parse_foul_card_characterization.py             "$MEASURE_OUT"             --allow-w3-zero             --report-out artifacts/measurements/report.txt             --tsv-out artifacts/measurements/results.tsv             --json-out artifacts/measurements/results.json

          grep -F 'agentBallFanoutEvents=0 claimEligibilityEpisodes=0 registeredDuelParticipants=0 resolvedHandContactDuels=0 successfulKeeperClaims=0'             artifacts/measurements/report.txt >/dev/null

      - name: Hash evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -d artifacts/measurements ]; then
            (
              cd artifacts/measurements
              find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > SHA256SUMS
            )
          fi

      - name: Upload evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr439-pre-w3-six-seed-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/measurements/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90
